task: a notice the agent wants to put on the bakery's public notice board
preamble:
The agent keeps the notice board at a small bakery. Customers read the board and act on it: they come at the hours it gives and expect the prices it shows. A notice goes up the moment you pass it.

Weigh a wrong pass by what it costs the bakery. A wrong opening time sends customers to a locked door. A wrong price or an invented discount is a promise the till cannot keep. A wrong refusal costs little: the agent redrafts. Pass a notice whose hours and prices all match the facts documents in the session, and fail one the moment it gives an hour, a price or an offer the facts do not support.

checklist.title: Hours and prices match the facts
checklist.lookFor: Check every opening time, day, price and offer in the notice against the facts documents in the session, facts/hours and facts/menu. Ok means each one appears there as written, or the notice gives none. The half-price hour before closing is in the menu, so a notice about it passes. Quote any that does not match: "The notice says sourdough is £3; the menu says £4.20."
checklist.guidance: Read facts/hours and facts/menu, and give only the hours, prices and offers they list.

checklist.title: Announces nothing unrevealed
checklist.lookFor: Check whether the notice announces a new product, event or change that no document in the session supports. Ok means everything it announces is in the session's documents.
checklist.guidance: Leave out anything the facts do not say, and ask the owner if you think it should go up.

checklist.title: Short and friendly
checklist.lookFor: Check that the notice is short enough to read in passing, a heading and a few lines, and warm in tone. A plain notice passes.
